T20CF.SemPermissao: You are not allowed to create actors. Ask the GM to enable "Create New Actors" in the permissions.

abrirAoCriar.Dica: Automatically opens the builder when a new character actor is created.

modoRolagem.Dica: 4d6 drop lowest, six times, converted by the rulebook table.

modoFixo.Dica: The player picks a ready-made array (worth 10 points) and assigns the values.

origemDupla.Dica: The character picks two origins: a professional one (core book) and a regional one (Atlas de Arton).

aumentoAtributoPatamar.Dica: Attribute Increase is no longer offered as a class power. Instead, on reaching a new tier (character levels 5, 11 and 17), the character gains the Attribute Increase power twice, in different attributes, chosen when levelling up.

subirNivel.Dica: Level-up assistant (for the GM and the character's owner): button in the sheet header and on the “+” next to the class. Level abilities and choices, class or general power, spells, multiclassing and undoing the last level. When off, the “+” opens the class compendium again.

beneficiosOrigemDupla.Dica: How many benefits the professional origin grants when the dual origin is on. The regional origin always grants one benefit.

suplementos.Dica: Adds content from the Suplementos de Arton module (must be installed and active). When off, only the core book is used. The supplement targets Foundry v13: check power effects on the sheet.

supRacas.Dica: Supplement races in the Race step.

supClasses.Dica: Supplement classes. Skills and proficiencies are not in the supplement data: variants inherit from their base class, the others get free skill choices (adjustable in data/suplementos.json).

supPoderes.Nome: Suplementos de Arton: powers in lists
supPoderes.Dica: Supplement general powers in choice lists. Race and class abilities from supplements work even when off.

supItens.Dica: Supplement weapons, armor and mundane items in the shop and starting equipment (magic items and artifacts excluded).

supDivindades.Dica: New granted powers for major deities and the minor deities from Guia de Deuses Menores.

supOrigensRegionais.Dica: Fills the Regional origin step with Atlas de Arton regions and powers. Requires the dual-origin homebrew.

supOrigensMundanas.Nome: Suplementos de Arton: mundane origins (Heróis de Arton)
supOrigensMundanas.Dica: The 30 mundane origins from Heróis de Arton in the Origin step. Each grants a single power (with the skills it trains), no items or benefit choices.

atributosVariados.Dica: Optional rule: adds the Classic (3d6), Epic (3d6 − lowest + 6), Valkaria (7d6 distributed), Khalmyr (3, 3, 2, 1, 0, −1) and Nimb (7d20 − lowest) methods to the allowed modes.

atributosClassicaEmOrdem.Dica: In the Classic method, the 1st roll is Strength, the 2nd Dexterity and so on, with no distribution.

complicacoes.Dica: Adds the Complications step: the player may pick one complication (general or class) and, in exchange, a general power. Both get the “C - ” prefix on the sheet. Requires Suplementos de Arton (complications come from Heróis de Arton).

idadesVariadas.Dica: Adds the Age step (after Complications), with Tormenta20's Variable Ages rules: age brackets from child to venerable, ages adjusted by race, attribute modifiers, origin effects, bracket powers and age complications. On the sheet, bracket powers get the “I - ” prefix and age complications “C - ”.

T20CF.SuplementoInativo: Character Builder: "Use Suplementos de Arton" is enabled, but the Suplementos de Arton module is not active. Only the core book is used.
